name: Himesato Sae
source: Class 3-11's homeroom teacher who is in her late 20s, and teaches languages. Sae has a strict and violent personality, not to mention she has an addiction with gambling and drinking, which her parents don't see as a problem for some reason. Despite this, she cherishes her students very much.
